task: ae.elevator: deterministic multi-car elevator dispatch simulation with invariant checker
reasoning_summary: Designed a tick-ordered simulation (arrivals, cost-based dispatch, per-car door/move step) in TASK.md, wrote hand-derived traces first, then implemented. The first run livelocked because a full car at a call's floor was re-assigned the same call forever; fixed by making such cars ineligible and re-dispatching unserved calls. Invariant checks run after every tick of seeded random and heavy-load runs.
